The main takeaway from our work is that

we have a lot more to learn from the past. The book's main purpose is to provide a corrective to the Western bias in travel writing, and to show how the West is not the only source of travel writing, and how

the world was a much more interconnected place in the past than we tend to think today, and that the world was not divided into the West and the Rest as is often assumed today, but rather that there were many worlds.
